Python — Hand-eye-marked.

Correspond calibration.py.SDK The robotic configuration, tablet position collection, hand-eye relationship calculations and precision checks can be done independently of the camera web page, which pre-selects the robot.

API Reference

get_robot_library(ip)

Purpose: Read all the robotic brands, models and place-forming rules.

Parameters

Name Type Description

ip

str

Camera address.

Returns: dict[str,list[dict]] or None.

configure_handeye_calibration(ip, params)

Purpose: Writes how to install and how to express the full position of the selected robot.

Parameters

Name Type Description

ip

str

Camera address.

params

ConfigureHandEyeCalibrationParams

Request parameters.

Returns: Successfully returned True.

get_handeye_calibration_data(ip)

Purpose: Read the context of the hand-eye currently saved by the camera for status queries, no Example Initialization of the robotic configuration as a prerequisite.

Parameters

Name Type Description

ip

str

Camera address.

Returns: The context is marked with the hand. dict or None.

get_calibration_board_pose(ip)

Purpose: Activate the photograph and test the plate, return to its camera coordinates position and collect diagnostic data.

Parameters

Name Type Description

ip

str

Camera address.

Returns: Mark tablet position dict or None.

calculate_handeye_calibration_result(ip, params)

Purpose: Use paired robot position and plate position to calculate hand eye changes.

Parameters

Name Type Description

ip

str

Camera address.

calculate_handeye_calibration_result_params

Union[Dict[str, Any, CalculateHandEyeCalibrationResultParams]]

Value of calculate_handeye_calibration_result_params.

Returns: Hand-Eye Calculator dict or None.

calculate_robot_accuracy(ip, params)

Purpose: The mobility accuracy of robots is calculated based on the starting point, endpoint position and plate position.

Parameters

Name Type Description

ip

str

Camera address.

params

CalculateRobotAccuracyParams

Request parameters.

Returns: The results of the robot’s precision. dict or None.

calculate_handeye_accuracy(ip, params)

Purpose: The newly collected plate position is converted to the robotic coordinate system using the saved hand-eye results.

Parameters

Name Type Description

ip

str

Camera address.

params

CalculateHandEyeAccuracyParams

Request parameters.

Returns: Accuracy of the hands and eyes. dict or None. == Independent Initializing Robot Configuration

library = epiceye.get_robot_library(ip)
first_brand, models = next(iter(library.items()))
first = models[0]

robot = RobotParameters(
    brand=first["brand"],
    model=first["model"],
    rotationType=first["rotationType"],
    eulerType=first["eulerType"],
    angleUnit=first["angleUnit"],
    axisNumber=first["axisNumber"],
    marks=first["marks"],
)
epiceye.configure_handeye_calibration(ip, ConfigureHandEyeCalibrationParams("ETH", robot))

The robot position has to be pressed. marks . The corner, fixed angle, rotation vector is 6 Number of values, four dollars 7 a value.

Full Interactive Example

python <SDK_DIR>/python/examples/hand_eye_calibration.py 192.168.1.100:5000

Example You can read the complete robot library, choose the first model of the first brand by default and write its attitude rules, then complete the installation selection, point-by-point collection, robot position input, result computation, robotic accuracy check and hand-eye accuracy check. robotPose We have to do the same thing. boardPoseArray Matches.

Result hecError valid field is rotMean, rotMax, transMean, transMax;symmetrical of averages/Maximum rotation error and average/Maximum offset error.
